description: Edito-Pdf lets you search, read, and analyze documents that have been pseudonymized or anonymized by the Omissis system. Using ChatGPT, you can locate files across your personal drive and shared drives, extract their text, and generate professional reports or summaries. When a document needs to be sent with real data restored, Omissis performs de-pseudonymization automatically and delivers the result to your email — without ever exposing sensitive information in the conversation.
